tuikio.description: Tuikio brings real terminal games to Android, turning your phone into a portable playground for classic text-based adventures, arcade games, puzzles, and roguelikes. Instead of simulating gameplay, it runs native game executables inside a built-in terminal emulator, complete with game-specific touch controls, customizable layouts, and support for physical keyboards and gamepads. Its colorful interface offers interchangeable themes and launcher identities, while a growing game catalog makes discovering new titles easy. Players can also suggest games, contribute ports, and share their own creations through a community-driven submission system. The project currently bundles 9 games and documents 169 playable titles, with broader Android compatibility testing still in progress.
